SetConfig.title: Ceremonial Set
SetConfig.description: A named ceremonial music set containing an ordered list of track buttons.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ceremonial set.

legacyId.description: Optional numeric legacy ID for backwards-compatible ?set= URLs.

label.description: Display label shown on the Home Screen set button.

sourceFile.description: Optional legacy JSON filename this set was migrated from.

order.description: Zero-based display order index on the Home Screen.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the set was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the set was last updated.

TrackButton.title: Track Button
TrackButton.description: A single audio cue button within a ceremonial set.

id.description: Unique identifier for the track button.

title.description: Button label text displayed on the console grid.

file.description: Relative audio path (e.g., audio/1-Open-1st-SMIB-Faster.mp3) or URL.

cue.description: Visual directive cue banner text shown when the button is selected.

lyrics.description: Ordered lines of lyrics or ceremonial notes displayed below the cue banner.

order.description: Zero-based display order index within the set.

lockedTop.description: Optional flag to keep this button locked at the top of the console grid so it does not scroll.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the track button was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the track button was last updated.

AdminUser.title: Admin User
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator record for managing Lodge Music configurations.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/sets/{setId}.description: Publicly readable ceremonial music sets; writable only by verified administrators.

/sets/{setId}/tracks/{trackId}.description: Publicly readable ordered track buttons belonging to a set; writable only by verified administrators.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Administrator allowlist records; readable and writable only by verified administrators.
